description:
Get a list of healthIssue objects and their properties.

TIP: Lists Microsoft Defender for Identity health issues. Each has healthIssueType, severity (low, medium, high), displayName, description, recommendedActionCommands, status (open, closed, suppressed), domainName, sensorDNSName, and issueTypeId. Use to monitor Defender for Identity sensor health.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-identity-health-issues
